CLIP (with atom IDs): E10.011 | 00:25.00-00:30.00 | CAM | Close-up on the Mayor's hands gripping the rail.
E10.012 | 00:25.40-00:28.82 | DLG | SELENE (panicked, sweet) | "Smile, sister. It is your last night of freedom."
E10.013 | 00:30.00-00:34.00 | CAM | Medium two-shot of the Mayor and Tobin, the space between them charged.
E10.014 | 00:30.40-00:33.44 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (venomous, furious) | "Every wedding needs a widow. Why not two?"
E10.015 | 00:34.00-00:37.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Selene's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E10.016 | 00:34.20-00:37.00 | ACT | Selene kneels on the slick quay boards.
E10.017 | 00:34.40-00:36.80 | DLG | WIDOW HALLORAN (silken, cold) | "You were always too soft for this family."
E10.018 | 00:37.00-00:41.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E10.019 | 00:37.40-00:40.80 | DLG | SELENE (venomous, shrill) | "Smile, sister. It is your last night of freedom."
E10.020 | 00:39.50-00:41.00 | SFX | A string sting swells to a peak.
E10.021 | 00:41.00-00:46.00 | CAM | Wide shot of the storm-lashed harbour, lanterns swinging on the quay.
E10.022 | 00:41.40-00:44.06 | DLG | MARA (O.S., hopeful, furious) | "Then let them come with their torches!"
E10.023 | 00:46.00-00:51.00 | CAM | High wide shot of the crowded hall turning toward the door.
E10.024 | 00:46.40-00:49.44 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (cold, pompous) | "Order! I will have order in my hall!"
E10.025 | 00:51.00-00:54.00 | CAM | Extreme close-up on Mara's eyes, wet with sea spray.
E10.026 | 00:51.40-00:53.80 | DLG | MAYOR BRISK (O.S., pompous, nervous) | "Take the girl to the cells until morning."
E10.027 | 00:54.00-00:59.00 | CAM | Low angle on Corin framed against the lighthouse beam.
E10.028 | 00:54.40-00:58.80 | DLG | TOBIN THE FERRYMAN (gruff, kind) | "The boat leaves at the turn of the tide. Be on it."
KEY REVEALS OF THE SHOW: R01 (E1): [mock] Mara is accused of theft at her sister's betrothal feast until a hooded harbourmaster speaks for her
R02 (E2): [mock] The harbourmaster is revealed as Lord Corin Ashvale, thought drowned, and offers Mara a bargain
R03 (E3): [mock] On the wedding morning a poisoned cup forces Corin to choose between justice and Mara's family
R04 (E4): [mock] Selene spreads a rumour that Mara lit a false light to wreck a ship
R05 (E5): [mock] Tobin the ferryman reveals what he saw on the night of the feast
R06 (E6): [mock] The council votes to take the lighthouse from Mara
R07 (E7): [mock] Corin's past returns on a ship flying a black pennant
R08 (E8): [mock] Mara discovers her father's logbook hidden in the lamp room
